context_requirements: Expression of SLC29A1 (ENT1) to mediate adenosine reuptake inhibition
Adenosine receptor expression (ADORA1/2A/2B/3) to transduce extracellular adenosine signals
Adenosine kinase or other adenosine-metabolizing capacity to allow adenosine accumulation
Intact cAMP/PKA and MAPK signaling for transcriptional responses
falsifiers: No change in any of the proximal or late genes across all nine cell lines at 6 h and 24 h
Strong and consistent upregulation of proliferation markers (e.g., PCNA, MKI67, TOP2A) at 24 h
Lack of any dose-dependent or time-dependent transcriptional response in cell lines known to express SLC29A1
Predominant induction of generic stress programs (unfolded protein response, heat shock) without adenosine-pathway-specific genes
